assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:sylphiette@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Sylphiette bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.7) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V15, with explicitly attributed behavior from V01 and V08-V15 and V05 reports as context only. The model routes observations to its evidence index, the shared state and readiness ledger, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses; none of those is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only. Fitts appearances not attributed to Sylphiette scene by scene are excluded, as are the web novel, later light-novel volumes, adaptations, performed voice and reception.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's twenty-three selectors MT-SYM-ST01 to ST23: V01 village child, lessons, the overridden refusal and separation (ST01-ST02); V08 self-account, imagined relationship and withheld name (ST03-ST05); V09 newly attributed enrollment and dormitory events, the grief attack, the staged confession and the illness disclosure (ST06-ST09); V10 marriage, guest-discipline advice and household routine (ST10-ST12); V11 service priority, pregnancy and accepted expedition (ST13-ST14); V12 return discussion, household terms and Lucy's birth (ST15-ST16); V13 working mother and mediator (ST17-ST18); V14 jealousy, costly treatment for Nanahoshi and recovery (ST19-ST20); V15 viewpoint holder, technical contributor and rescuer, and new-household mediator (ST21-ST23). V02-V07 supply no observed state, no earlier state acquires later knowledge, the model names no default state, nothing after V15 is established and no in-world dates are fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The explanatory domains set out conflicting motives rather than one trait: gratitude toward a formative teacher beside an active wish to become capable, attachment that coexists with noticing her instrumental use in Ariel's service, wanting closeness and imagined exclusivity while fearing loss and wanting to stand beside Rudeus rather than beneath him; seven rules (MT-SYM-001 to 007) each carry a countercase and a discriminating test, and the always-compliant reading is rejected by the Luke refusal and the childhood protest. The model rates mechanism confidence only moderate, its tests are retrospective fits under disclosed prior franchise familiarity rather than holdouts, and its per-volume extensions are compressed into terse qualifications, so B is not supported; explicit competing motives with falsifiers exceed distributed description, so D is not supported.

Twenty-three selectors track a real developmental arc (bullied village child, student-attendant in disguise, wife, working mother, viewpoint holder and rescuer) with each rule extended or marked untested volume by volume from V09 to V15 and an explicit bar on earlier states acquiring later knowledge. Each selector is a single line, V02-V07 are offstage, no default state is named, and the volume qualifications rarely separate what changed from what was newly revealed beyond the REVEALED_NOT_NEW tags, so B is not supported; volume-bound selectors with change kinds exceed an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

The model limits itself to written speech and records only described contrasts: explicit childhood protest against school-setting hesitation, inward wishes denied in conversation, differentiated address within service and a V09 preference for informal speech (024-026). It quotes no Japanese wording, self-reference or address form and locates no register token, and it refuses importing Fitts-role speech, actor delivery or a stock submissive voice. That supports bounded questions about when she speaks plainly versus hesitates, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it, but described contrasts without located wording do not reach D.

Ordinary contexts are located across volumes: running, lessons and practical study (V08-V09), reserving mana for guard duty, savings and the house (V10), daily routine and reciprocal lessons (V10:016), household teaching and care (V11-V13), her own earnings and grades (V13:020/028), a hat gift to Roxy (V13:023) and childcare choices (V15). The model states that food and leisure beyond represented detail and independent household management remain uncertain, and each act is a one-line chapter citation, so C is not supported; several distinct located ordinary acts exceed a single local mention, so E is not supported.

Responses are differentiated by recipient with chapter loci: Rudeus across childhood protest, inhibited disclosure, chosen marriage, explicit boundaries and requests for openness; Ariel as valued friend and employer whose service she keeps after marriage and motherhood; refusal of Luke's suggestion; stopping Norn speaking for her and defending her later; welcoming Roxy with a gift; encouraging Sara's repair; costly treatment for Nanahoshi despite jealousy; conditions on and later restrained irritation with Eris. Outside Rudeus each relation rests on one or two cited chapters with terse notes, and the model leaves unknown political negotiation open, so B is not supported; recipient-specific responses with countercases exceed generic description, so D is not supported.

The model's D0 level covers represented interiority: her V08 interlude self-account of study, service and bereavement (S107), the private imagined relationship and fear of abandonment (S108), the late V09 interlude, her private fear in V12 (030), fear of being blamed during Nanahoshi's collapse (V14:010) and V15, where she holds the viewpoint (ST21). Interior access is therefore located across several states, but the model summarizes it in compressed lines, rates mechanisms moderate and does not map interior states outside the Rudeus relationship and household, so B is not supported; repeated located self-account and viewpoint material exceed distributed mentions, so D is not supported.

Conflict responses are located with falsifiers: the V01 explicit refusal and protest at separation, the V09 grief-driven attack on Rudeus that stops after the missing context is explained (MT-SYM-006, single cluster), the Luke refusal, a rebuke over injury with a request for ordinary apology (V10:018), explicit marital limits (V13:015/018), objections to protective exclusion and negotiation of a meaningful role (V15:008-009) and restrained real anger with Eris (V15:033). The aggression rule rests on one cluster and is UNTESTED in every later volume, physical conflict is thin (in V15 Rudeus performs the combat she enabled) and the model cautions against a general aggression trait, so B is not supported; repeated located interpersonal conflict with explicit countercases exceeds distributed description, so D is not supported.

The model locates morally loaded choices: the V09 rejection of secret dosing alongside incomplete disclosure of substance risks (V09:027-028), the V10 recommendation of coercive discipline for subordinate guests, which it records as an ethical contradiction rather than wisdom (MT-SYM-007, single instance), the self-initiated costly donation to Nanahoshi (V14:010-011), and the marriage counterfactual that keeps her Ariel loyalty (V11:002). Her reasoning in these choices is given only in a phrase, the punitive advice is a single untested instance and political choices remain unknown, so C is not supported; several located choices with recorded contradictions exceed a single local mention, so E is not supported.

The model mentions only that the service setting permits friendship and teasing, locates no humorous or playful instance and models no function for play. Absence of located evidence is not treated as a trait or an inability.

One curated item: the model, which extends systematically through each volume in which she appears (V01, V08-V15) with chapter-located rule qualifications and 35 retrospective checks. V02-V07 contribute only V05 reports, Fitts appearances not attributed scene by scene are excluded, her story continues past V15, and the evidence index, state ledger, deep readings and checkpoints that hold the underlying observations are not curated on her row, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of every admitted volume she appears in exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative limits and countercases: the V01 refusal and the Luke refusal against an always-compliant reading, the V10 punitive advice as an ethical contradiction, incomplete risk disclosure despite a care motive (V09:027-028), her refusal of blanket marital permission (V13:015/018), startled resistance before reciprocating an embrace (V14:022), Rudeus rather than Sylphiette performing combat use of the skill she taught, and the scene-by-scene Fitts attribution limit. Several countercases are single scenes compressed into one line and the model calls all checks retrospective, so B is not supported; located, witnessed countercases exceed generic caution, so D is not supported.

Every selector and rule extension is bound to a volume and chapter, earlier states are barred from later knowledge, and the V08 Fitts attribution is kept historical rather than rewritten by V09. A is not supported because there are no in-world dates and B is not supported because the model names no default state and its single-line selectors do not specify per-event receipt; D is not supported because states are volume- and chapter-bound rather than loose period labels.

scenario_readiness.note: The model is written-speech only, quotes no wording, locates no register token and bars importing Fitts-role speech, actor delivery or a stock submissive voice; it supplies no unseen exact dialogue. CONDITIONAL would build dialogue from described contrasts alone; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the model's explicit speech limits.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-SYM-ST01 to ST23 between V01 and V15, with that state's knowledge only; nothing after V15 and no later knowledge in an earlier state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Rudeus as childhood teacher, unrecognizing schoolmate and later husband; Ariel as friend and employer; Luke as fellow attendant; Norn, Roxy, Sara, Nanahoshi and Eris within their located contacts; Lucy as her infant daughter.
setting_constraints: The village, the university and Ariel's service, and the household of the Japanese light novels V01-V15
No modern setting, institution or technology outside the source
No unattributed Fitts appearance, unseen skill, diagnosis, adult-intimacy scene or future knowledge
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits only D0 represented behavior and D1 near-analog extension within named contexts, says all admitted domains remain BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL and that unfamiliar situations require abstention, and lists unfamiliar politics, adult intimacy, complete disguise performance and audiovisual delivery as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; its checks are retrospective under prior familiarity. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

Located ordinary scenes (study, routine, household teaching, a gift, earnings) are single-line citations, and the model leaves food, leisure and independent household management uncertain. CONDITIONAL would construct ordinary social life from compressed mentions; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located ordinary acts.

The evidence locates outcomes of morally loaded choices and records a punitive-advice contradiction, but gives her reasoning only in phrases and leaves political choices unknown. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the model does not describe; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located choices.

The relationship with Rudeus is extensively located (inhibited disclosure, confession, marriage, explicit boundaries, jealousy), but the model rules out a mature romantic or adult-intimacy persona and generated sexualized scenarios, insists that marriage and motherhood do not supply blanket consent and treats each event's consent separately. CONDITIONAL would license the romantic persona the model refuses; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located relationship and its stated limits.

Her service to Ariel is located as a motive and commitment (mana reserved for guard duty, continued work after marriage and motherhood, independent friendship as a reason to serve, a return to the work in V14), and she contributes technically in V15, but on-duty conduct is barely represented and the model leaves political negotiation uncertain. CONDITIONAL would supply professional behavior from stated loyalties rather than observed work; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located service commitments.

known_limits.statement: Fitts is a role shared with Ariel; only scenes the source explicitly attributes to Sylphiette count, V09's retrospective attribution does not rewrite the V08 knowledge state, and unattributed Fitts appearances supply no evidence.
Marriage, motherhood and expressed affection do not establish blanket consent or retirement: she states particular limits, refuses blanket marital permission and negotiates terms event by event.
The grief-driven attack (MT-SYM-006) and the coercive guest-discipline advice (MT-SYM-007) each rest on a single cluster and are untested in every later volume; neither is a general disposition.
The model is restricted to written speech, quotes no Japanese wording and supplies no unseen exact dialogue, performed voice or stock submissive register.

All 35 checks are retrospective source fits selected after reading under disclosed prior franchise familiarity, not holdouts or numerical forecasts; scene confidence is high and mechanism confidence moderate, and the model's own BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL label is a ceiling, not a capability grade.

The evidence index, shared state and readiness ledger, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses to which the model routes every observation are not curated on this subject, so its chapter locators were not rechecked and its compressed rule qualifications could not be expanded here. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
V02-V07 supply no observed state (V05 reports are context only), and the model ends at V15; nothing later in her story is assessed.
